description: This file defines a set of string labels for various configuration fields used within the project, organized as a record mapping configuration keys to human-readable labels. It imports labels from media-audio-field-metadata.js and includes numerous project-specific configuration keys, covering areas like environment, diagnostics, logging, CLI, updates, agents, gateway, media, tools, approvals, commands, MCP, UI, web, discovery, canvas, talk, messages, channels, agents, plugins, hooks, web sockets, discovery, plugins, and more. Its main purpose is to provide descriptive labels for configuration options, likely for UI display or documentation.
